# A grower offered you a fee per hive. Does it clear your costs?

> Free pollination contract checker for beekeepers: enter the fee per hive, miles, inspection failures, feed and losses, and see your net per hive and break-even fee. Growers can see cost per acre. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
